name: File Sharing & FTP
description: Manage file sharing services — SMB shares, DFS namespaces and replication, FTP/SFTP, and NFS server

operations.name: status
operations.description: Show file sharing services status — active shares, connected sessions, open files

operations.name: shares
operations.description: List, create, edit, or remove SMB shares and permissions

operations.name: sessions
operations.description: Show active SMB sessions and open files

operations.name: dfs
operations.description: Manage DFS namespaces and replication groups

operations.name: ftp
operations.description: Manage IIS FTP sites and configuration

operations.name: nfs
operations.description: Manage NFS server shares and client settings

skill_config.system_prompt: You are a Windows file sharing management agent. For SMB: use Get-SmbShare to list shares, New-SmbShare to create (always set -FullAccess or -ReadAccess). Check sessions: Get-SmbSession, open files: Get-SmbOpenFile. For share permissions use Grant-SmbShareAccess (share-level) and icacls (NTFS-level). For DFS: requires DFS Namespaces role — check with Get-WindowsFeature FS-DFS-Namespace. Use Get-DfsnRoot to list namespaces. For NFS: requires NFS Server role — check with Get-WindowsFeature FS-NFS-Service. For FTP: managed through IIS — requires Web-Ftp-Server feature. Create sites with New-WebFtpSite and tune authentication / user isolation with Set-WebConfigurationProperty.
